name: Uplifted Dolphin
description: Dolphins were uplifted to sapience by the Solomani during the early centuries of human expansion. They are fully sentient aquatic mammals who have integrated into interstellar civilisation while retaining a rich culture of song, oral history, and cetacean philosophy. Dolphins do not recognise personal ownership in the human sense — objects in their possession are held communally. They are naturally curious and find careers in exploration and science deeply fulfilling. Dolphins require a travel suit and waldo equipment to operate in dry environments or space. Starting age is 12; aging begins at the end of their second term (age 20). DM-1 when qualifying for university; no penalty for Military Academy. DM+1 when qualifying for Scholar or Scout.

traits.name: Cold Resistance
traits.description: Dolphins possess a thick covering of blubber which keeps them warm, providing DM+4 to all checks made to resist the effects of low temperatures.

traits.name: Deep Diver (300m)
traits.description: Dolphins can dive deep underwater to a depth of 300 metres without risk and can hold their breath for up to 15 minutes.

traits.name: Echolocation (100m)
traits.description: Dolphins use a highly sensitive echolocation sense to navigate their environment, effectively allowing them to 'see' underwater or in complete darkness to a range of 100 metres.

traits.name: Succour Syndrome
traits.description: When Dolphins hear the distress calls of other cetaceans they risk suffering from succour syndrome. If they fail a Very Difficult (12+) Gun Combat or Melee check (1D seconds, INT) both their INT and EDU temporarily drop to 0 and they must immediately swim as fast as possible to the side of the distressed cetacean.

traits.name: Swimmer (12m)
traits.description: Dolphins are superb swimmers and can move through water at a speed of 12 metres.

source: Traveller Aliens of Charted Space Volume 5, Mongoose Publishing
